system.name: MM-FSS (MultiModal Few-Shot SegNet)
system.one_liner: A few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation model that adds free text labels and implicitly learned 2D features to the point cloud input.

content.variant_note: the unimodal baseline and the proposed multimodal model in mirrored lanes on the same scene; only the right lane has text and 2D image inputs
content.argues: Adding the class name and simulated 2D features to few-shot point cloud segmentation costs no extra annotation: text is free, and 2D images are used only in pretraining.
content.subject: support, mask and query point clouds into a unimodal and a multimodal few-shot model; text and 2D images join the multimodal one

lessons.what_to_learn: Draw the baseline and the proposed model in mirrored lanes on the same sample scene, so the extra inputs (a text chip, a stack of photos) are the only visible difference, and use a small arrow-colour key to say which inputs exist only in pretraining.
lessons.suits: Papers that add inputs or modalities to an existing task and want to show the added cost is small, with the model kept as one black box.

evidence: During meta-learning and inference, the 2D modality is not needed.
Thus, the multimodal information used by us is cost-free, as shown in Fig. 1.

summary: MM-FSS extends few-shot 3D point cloud segmentation with two extra modalities that cost no annotation: the class name as text and 2D images of the scene. Figure 1 puts the traditional unimodal pipeline on the left and the proposed multimodal pipeline on the right, split by a dashed vertical line and drawn on the same indoor scene. In both lanes a support cloud with its black-and-red mask and a query cloud enter a single Few-shot Model box that returns a predicted mask. The right lane adds a pink Chair text chip and a stack of 2D photos, and a dashed key explains that taupe arrows are used in training and inference while the green 2D arrow is used only in pretraining.
summary_zh: MM-FSS 在少样本三维点云分割中加入免费的类别名文本和 2D 图像。图 1 用虚线分成左右两条泳道：左为单模态，右为多模态，同一场景输入支持集、掩码和查询点云；右侧多出 Chair 文本框和 2D 图像堆，图例说明 2D 仅用于预训练。
notes: Prior labels counted two panels; the halves have no frame, letter or title (only a dashed divider), so they are recorded as two lanes in one drawing. The 15 placed bitmaps include the two model boxes, the Chair chip and the legend arrow sample besides the photos and masks.
